title: Talent Acquisition Lead (Hunting) - Trabalho Remoto | REF#284379
description:
Talent Acquisition Lead (Hunting) – Trabalho Remoto | REF#

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.

Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.

Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Talent Acquisition Lead (Hunting) na BairesDev. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Talent Acquisition Lead (Hunting), contribuindo com o desenvolvimento e execução de nossas estratégias para atrair e engajar profissionais de alto nível para o nosso time. Nessa vaga, você vai liderar um time de headhunters focados em identificar e abordar profissionais de alto nível através do LinkedIn e outras plataformas. Você também deverá trabalhar em conjunto com outros times para entender os requisitos de cada vaga, definir as estratégias de atração de talentos e executar ações para manter uma pipeline de talentos robusta para nossos projetos. Essa é uma vaga de alta performance e estratégica para nosso crescimento.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Liderar e mentorar um time de Analistas de Talent Acquisition, definindo prioridades e guiando suas tarefas diárias.
  • Atuar junto a lideranças para entender as necessidades de cada projeto, os requisitos técnicos e o perfil ideal de cada vaga.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de headhunting para identificar ativamente profissionais de alto nível através do LinkedIn, redes sociais e outras plataformas de atração.
  • Classificar candidaturas com base em testes e entrevistas, garantindo o alinhamento com as necessidades dos times.

O Que Buscamos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com recrutamento para TI, com foco em atração de talentos e headhunting.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano liderando ou gerenciando times de recrutamento ou atração de talentos.
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e em constante mudança.
  • Entendimento profundo sobre headhunting para a área de TI.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil

  • Modalidade 100% remota – trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou em sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.
  • Horários flexíveis – faça seu próprio horário.
  • Licença parental remunerada, férias e feriados nacionais.
  • Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.
  • Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.
  • Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

Sales at TRACTIAN

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly.

Desde então, temos atuado em diversos segmentos da economia brasileira, como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico e siderúrgico. Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.

Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Orientar projetistas de equipamentos rotativos e HVAC, garantindo conformidade com ASME, API, ISO, NR e normas PETROBRAS;
  • Elaborar, revisar e aprovar desenhos 2D/3D, data-sheets, especificações, memórias de cálculo e estudos técnicos ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto;
  • Definir listas de documentos, cronogramas, quantificações e prioridades, alinhando recursos e milestones com o PMO;
  • Desenvolver procedimentos, templates e padrões para modelos 3D/2D, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência documental;
  • Avaliar interferências de equipamentos/HVAC na rotina da plataforma, propondo mitigação de vibração, ruído, cargas térmicas e disponibilidade mecânica;
  • Planejar FATs, pré-operação e partida; emitir LVs/FVIs, registrar pendências e garantir atendimento às normas regulatórias;
  • Acompanhar fabricação, montagem e inspeção em fornecedores e unidades offshore, respondendo emergências e consultas técnicas;
  • Coordenar ou apoiar projetos uni/multidisciplinares, revisar documentos de contratadas e participar de GTs, auditorias e reuniões;
  • Especificar materiais, prospectar fornecedores/tecnologias e emitir pareceres técnicos para compras estratégicas de equipamentos dinâmicos e sistemas HVAC;
  • Supervisionar equipe, monitorar qualidade dos serviços e promover treinamentos para assegurar construtibilidade e performance operacional.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

  • Graduação em Engenharia (Preferencialmente Mecânica ou correlata)

  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA na área de atuação ou Gestão de Projetos

Senior Software Engineer (Python)

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting‑edge technology, agile thinking, and a people‑first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end‑to‑end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in‑store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi‑billion‑dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from one of our offices in São Paulo (2 times/ week or 8 days/ month) or Porto Alegre (3 times/ week or 12 days/ month). Our WFN culture is designed to foster in‑person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Engineer (Python), you will be a key member of our growing, globally distributed Engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust and scalable Python‑based applications and services. Working with team members across multiple geographies, you will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver high‑quality software solutions while ensuring best practices in software development and system architecture. Strong English communication skills are essential for effective collaboration in this diverse and international environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable, high‑performing, secure, and reliable Python applications that address diverse business needs

Bonus Points

  • Experience with message queuing systems
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you'll work with world‑class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech‑driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps‑first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

Through strategic customer relationships, Worldly offers insights into supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. Backed by a dedicated global team and mission‑aligned investors, Worldly operates as a public benefit corporation focused on sustainable impact.

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Full‑Stack Developer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining a large‑scale Angular front‑end application, as well as building and integrating back‑end systems using ExpressJS and various database technologies.

What You'll Do

  • Design and develop complex, scalable, and high‑performance Angular applications using the latest version of Angular and related technologies.

  • Write clean, well‑documented, and testable code using industry‑standard coding practices.

  • Experience with NGRX for state management and RxJS for reactive programming.
  • Familiarity with building reusable and testable Angular components, services, and modules.
  • Experience with ExpressJS and Node.js for building RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Proficient in working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and document‑based databases (e.g., MongoDB).
  • Knowledge of web networking protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, WebSockets) and security best practices (authentication, authorization, encryption).
  • Experience with front‑end build tools and processes, such as Webpack, Gulp, or Grunt.
  • Knowledge of responsive web design and cross‑browser compatibility techniques.
  • Proficient in version control systems, such as Git.
  • Strong problem‑solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

It Helps If You Have

  • Experience with front‑end testing frameworks (e.g., Jasmine, Karma) and back‑end testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Mocha).
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and deployment processes (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and accessibility standards.
  • Familiarity with front‑end and back‑end performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience with Monorepos, ideally the NX Monorepo framework.
  • Experience with Kendo UI for Angular.

What We Can Offer You

  • Comprehensive benefits package – 100% of employee premiums covered by Worldly.

  • Company‑sponsored 401(k) with up to 4% match for US‑based employees.

Life at Worldly

Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level.

title: Director Structured Finance
description:
Director – Structured Finance (Brazil) – Location: São Paulo

About the Role

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Director to join the Structured Finance team in São Paulo. The Brazil SF team covers local-market transactions primarily structured via FIDCs, debentures, and securitization companies (CRIs and CRAs). As a Director, you will own a portfolio of complex credits, lead and develop analysts, set analytical direction, and represent Fitch externally. You will drive rating assignments and reviews across Asset Backes Securities and Structured Credit, including cash flow modeling, legal review, collateral analysis, committee leadership, and clear communication of credit opinions to issuers and investors.

What We Offer

  • Broad exposure to Structured Finance across asset classes and structures in Brazil and Latin America.
  • Hands-on use and development of Fitch criteria, models, tools, and analytical frameworks.
  • Direct engagement with market participants (originators, servicers, arrangers, investors).
  • A collaborative, high-performing team environment with opportunities to lead impactful research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio and Analysis: Take responsibility for a portfolio of complex SF transactions. Ensure timely, high-quality new ratings and surveillance.
  • Leadership and Execution: Lead, coach, and mentor analysts; set objectives and provide balanced, timely feedback. Supervise work quality and timelines, manage resources across changing priorities, resolve operational hurdles, and lead rating processes and management review meetings.
  • Research and Market Presence: Initiate and lead publishable research (special reports, market commentary). Share expertise across teams, contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and represent Fitch externally with originators, servicers, arrangers, investors, and at Fitch events.
  • Modeling, Legal, and Compliance: Oversee cash flow modeling and model use. Review and interpret legal documentation to align with criteria and analytical assumptions. Maintain thorough documentation and version control, and ensure adherence to compliance processes.
  • Communication and Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate rating rationales clearly in presale reports, press releases, presentations, and meetings. Facilitate effective communication within and across teams, encourage contributions, manage conflict constructively, and build strong market relationships.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, or related field.
  • Significant experience in structured finance/securitization within ratings, banking, asset management, or advisory.
  • Demonstrated leadership of analysts and portfolios; proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop talent.
  • Strong project management skills; able to manage complex, dynamic workloads and deliver on time.
  • Proficiency with cash flow modeling and performance analytics; comfort with criteria and model application.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English, including presenting to senior audiences and drafting publishable research.
  • Ability to read and interpret legal documents and participate effectively in meetings in Portuguese and English.
  • Team-oriented, with a track record of building effective internal and external relationships; high attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Line management experience (hiring, performance feedback, development planning).
  • Experience enhancing analytical tools, dashboards, or databases to drive productivity and insight.
  • Exposure to multiple SF asset classes (e.g., trade receivables, auto, SME) and to Latin America markets.

How You’ll Succeed

  • Deliver consistent, high-quality analysis and timely outputs across a diverse portfolio.
  • Elevate team capability through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • Lead insightful research that advances Fitch’s market presence.

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

title: Head of Global Partnerships
description:
Overview

Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information\'s 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Role

We are seeking a Head of Global Partnerships to architect, lead, and scale Jeeves’ partner ecosystem across our most strategic regions: North America, Latin America (focused on BR, MX, & CO), and EMEA. Reporting directly to the CRO, this leader will be responsible for shaping Jeeves’ partnership model across these key markets while maintaining a global perspective and framework for growth.

This role is best fit for a Builder! It will strengthen our existing broker-driven channels in high-growth markets like Brazil and Mexico while also pioneering new distribution models across referral based partnerships, technology platforms, embedded finance players, accounting networks, VC/PE ecosystems, travel and banking partners, advisory firms, and beyond.

You will operate as both strategic architect and hands-on dealmaker: setting the long-term vision for a high impact channel ecosystem that is responsible for driving a sizable portion of Jeeves revenue, building a world-class partner portfolio, and ensuring successful execution at every stage of the partnership lifecycle.

Location: This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil , and is a full-time position where it is required to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi. #LI-Hybrid

What You’ll Do

  • Define & Scale the Global Partnerships Strategy: Establish the vision, framework, and goals for Jeeves’ partner ecosystem, with a focus on scaling in North America, Latin America, and EMEA.
  • Expand Broker & Channel Performance: Strengthen and optimize existing broker channels while creating scalable playbooks for replication across multiple regions.
  • Diversify Strategic Partnerships: Build new categories of partnerships—technology integrations, embedded finance, advisory, CFO networks, accounting firms, banks, and venture ecosystems—to create durable, high-value revenue streams.
  • Lead End-to-End Partner Lifecycle: Drive the entire partnership cycle: sourcing, negotiation, deal structuring, onboarding, activation, and performance management.
  • Influence & Inspire Internally: Act as the internal champion for partner-led innovation, collaborating across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Legal to maximize partner impact.
  • Globalize Best Practices: Establish metrics, incentives, processes, and playbooks that can scale partnerships across multiple regions while aligning to Jeeves’ global growth agenda.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel leadership within fintech, SaaS, payments, or financial services; international experience required, with deep exposure to North America, Latin America, and/or EMEA.
  • Proven Growth Leader: Track record of designing and scaling partner ecosystems across multiple regions.
  • Commercial Acumen: Exceptional deal-making, negotiation, and execution skills with a strong record of closing high-impact partnerships.
  • Cross-Cultural Expertise: Ability to navigate diverse partner ecosystems across different geographies; familiarity with Brazil and LatAm markets is a strong plus.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and Portuguese required and Spanish strongly preferred; additional languages advantageous.
  • Strategic Vision + Operational Excellence: Ability to balance global strategy-setting with roll-up-your-sleeves execution.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and inspire high-performing international teams.

Why This Role Matters

Partnerships are a cornerstone of Jeeves’ growth strategy worldwide. As Head of Global Partnerships, you will define how Jeeves enters and scales in key regions, expanding distribution and revenue through innovative partner models.

If you’re a visionary leader, master negotiator, and team builder who thrives in high-growth global fintech environments—this is the opportunity to shape the future of how companies worldwide manage their finances.

description:
Responsibilities

The Global Business Solutions (GBS) team is responsible for the revenue growth of the TikTok business, and our teams include Sales, Marketing, Ops, Account Managers, Agency and partnerships, as well as Marketing Science. GBS is a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and ambitious client group, and our HRBPs who support them are too! TikTok's SMB team aims to help businesses and brands of all sizes unleash their creative side, connect with our audience, or perhaps be discovered! From designing scaled sales and service delivery programs to ensuring our customers have best-in-class tools and products at their fingertips, our SMB team combines operational expertise with a customer-centric mindset to help businesses achieve their marketing goals on TikTok, no matter how big or small. As the Head of SMB, LATAM, you will be responsible for leading the overall growth for the region, including revenue, advertiser development, and product adoption. This includes leadership responsibility for multiple sales functions as well as managing experienced people leaders. You will play a critical role in developing and executing a data-driven sales strategy, ensuring operational excellence, and fostering strong cross-functional collaboration across the global SMB organization. A balance between global alignment and regional customization will be key to success.

  • Accountable for achieving revenue targets for the LATAM market.

  • Run a quarterly forecasting cadence to provide visibility of sales pipeline status, plan to achieve targets, and assess upside/downside risks.
  • Drive advertiser acquisition and retention by enhancing product adoption and operational efficiencies.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing sales team, including managing multi-level leaders and sales functions.
  • Collaborate with key cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Sales Operations, and Ad Operations) to set go-to-market priorities and optimize revenue growth.
  • Identify and implement scalable operational improvements to support continued advertiser success.
  • Drive revenue organization productivity and efficiency improvements through data-driven insights.
  • Partner with strategy teams on annual budgeting, tracking key performance indicators, and providing insights and recommendations for deviations.
  • Maintain operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline development, training, hiring, performance management, collaboration, and sharing of best practices.

  • 10+ years of leadership & management experience in sales, advertising, or business development, with a focus on SMBs.
  • Proven track record of engaging product in sales go to market, including building in synergy with a product team where necessary
  • Strong analytical, strategic planning, and forecasting skills, with the ability to synthesize market insights and translate them into actionable strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations and drive alignment across multiple business functions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization. Comfortable with global travel.
  • Experience managing multi-level leaders and fostering team development.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for problem-solving and driving business transformation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • As this role covers the LATAM markets, full business fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred.
  • Experience in platform and scaled operations is considered a plus.
  • In-depth knowledge of the LATAM AdTech market and its SMB lead initiatives.

About ByteDance Brazil

ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. We strive to do great things with great people. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Gedragswetenschapper Pleegzorg
description:
Overzicht

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig " Jor" jetz

Pleegzorg vraagt om meer dan alleen goede bedoelingen. Pleegouders hebben intensieve begeleiding nodig om een veilige en stabiele omgeving voor kinderen te bieden, vaak in complexe situaties. Hulpverleners spelen daarin een sleutelrol, en als gedragswetenschapper coach jij hen om dit goed te kunnen doen. Je sluit aan bij hun vragen, denkt mee over casuïstiek rondom opvoeding, hechting en trauma, en vertaalt wetenschappelijke inzichten naar de praktijk van pleegzorg. Met jouw kennis en ervaring train je hulpverleners zodat zij pleegouders en kinderen optimaal kunnen begeleiden.

Daarnaast volg je de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en in de jeugdzorg en werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van pleegzorgconcepten. Samen met de teammanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én zorg je dat ons pleegzorgaanbod zichtbaar is bij gemeenten en samenwerkingspartners. Dat vraagt om analytisch inzicht, inspirerend leiderschap en onderzoekende nieuwsgierigheid. En in acute situaties wanneer er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van crisissituaties bij pleeggezinnen of plaatsingen treed je daadkrachtig en met helderheid op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de pleezorgbegeleiders zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Binnen Timon Amsterdam maak je deel uit van het team van Gedragswetenschappers en landelijk neem je deel aan de beleidsdagen/vergaderingen van het zorgconcept Pleegzorg. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Wil je meer zien over het werk van onze Gedragswetenschappers, bekijk dan hier het filmpje van Helga, een van onze Gedragswetenschappers binnen Timon.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je stuurt met de teammanager het team duaal aan.
  • Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals bv CJG en Jeugdbescherming.
  • Je maakt kwartaalrapportages en analyseert de uitkomsten inhoudelijk.
  • Je bent betrokken bij het nemen van kernbeslissingen.
  • Je biedt nabijheid en coaching on the job aan het team.

“Als gedragswetenschapper ben je betrokken bij het beleid en bij de uitvoering daarvan door begeleiders. Dat maakt dit werk veelzijdig en waardevol”

Susanne Kooij, gedragswetenschapper jeugdzorg

Dit vragen we van je

Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis: gedragswetenschapper. Je bent analytisch sterk, sociaal en slagvaardig. Daarnaast kun je goed werken op individuele basis. Verder beschik je over:

  • Een universitair masterdiploma richting gedragswetenschappen en/of psychologie en/of pedagogische wetenschappen;
  • Kennis van gedragsproblematiek en -stoornissen en ervaring met erkende therapeutische (crisis)interventies en behandelmethoden;
  • Kennis van gezinsproblematiek, systemische interventies en van de ontwikkeling van kind tot puber;
  • Ervaring met het coachen van teams;
  • Kennis van de wet- en regelgeving;
  • SKJ registratie;
  • Ervaring binnen de pleegzorg is een pré.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao jeugdzorg (schaal 11) van € 3.972,06 tot € 6.002,30, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;
  • Jaarcontract. Bevalt het wederzijds? Dan zetten we dit om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris;
  • Trainingen en opleiding gericht op jouw functie.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor gedragswetenschapper Pleegzorg. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Suzanne Kooij-Groeneveld (gedragswetenschapper), tel. of Bouke Hartman (regiomanager), tel. . Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter Kitty Bernardus, tel. .

The Director of Clinical Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical services across multiple departments. The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams, optimize patient throughput, and foster collaboration among clinical and administrative stakeholders.

Clinical Operations Oversight

  • Implement and monitor KPIs such as patient wait times, double-booking volume, appointment utilization rates, and provider panel sizes to drive operational efficiency.

  • Facilitate regular strategy sessions with senior leadership, department chairs, and finance teams to align clinical and financial priorities.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop clinical operations managers and support staff.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centered care.
  • Ensure staff compliance with policies, procedures, and performance standards.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Partner with finance teams to develop and manage budgets for clinical operations.
  • Monitor revenue cycle performance and implement strategies to optimize reimbursement.
  • Support strategic planning initiatives, including expansion of service lines and adoption of innovative care models.

Quality & Compliance

  • Lead operational readiness for audits and inspections.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Senior Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Resource Planning and Allocation Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities. Maintain a real‑time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization. Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements. Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset. Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success. Maintain up‑to‑date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements. Identify resource gaps and recommend cross‑training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities. Support long‑term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance. Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency. Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike. Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts. Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created. If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling Review unassigned Wrike projects daily. Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs. Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders. Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight Cross‑reference Salesforce‑Wrike and Wrike‑NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy. Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing. Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately. Monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues as needed. Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur. Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants. Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed. Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers. Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers. Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations. Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments. Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics. Monitor workload balance across consultants. Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast. Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Experience: 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast‑paced environment. Skills: Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike). Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, and NetSuite preferred. Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

description:
Solutions Architect - Mobility Integrations

Job Locations: BR-SP-Sao Paulo

Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

Our technical team is the engine that powers our most innovative partnerships. We are the bridge between 99's platform and the outside world, designing and implementing the integrations that make ambitious ideas a reality. As a Solutions Architect, you will be the lead technical expert for Brazil, architecting API integrations with public and private entities and building automations that streamline our business processes. This role is crucial for our expansion into MaaS and beyond.

Role Responsibilities

  • Leading the technical discovery and design for integrations with external partners, primarily focusing on REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Architecting robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions that connect 99's platform with third-party systems.
  • Developing business process automations using both front-end and back-end technologies to improve internal efficiency and partnership operations.
  • Acting as the primary technical liaison between Brazilian partners and our global Product Management teams in China, requiring excellent English communication skills.
  • Writing clear technical documentation, specifications, and diagrams to guide development and ensure alignment across all teams.
  • Troubleshooting complex technical issues during and after implementation, providing expert guidance to ensure project success.

Role Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, API Specialist, Integration Engineer, or Full-Stack Developer.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in designing and consuming APIs (REST, SOAP) and working with common data formats (JSON, XML).
  • Proven experience in process automation with proficiency in back-end (e.g., Python, Node.js) and front-end (e.g., JavaScript) technologies.
  • Excellent professional proficiency in English, with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to international teams.
  • A problem-solver's mindset, with the ability to analyze complex systems and design elegant, effective solutions. Experience with public transport data standards (GTFS/GTFS-RT) is a major bonus.

EEO Statement

We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.

We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

This position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Senior Legal Counsel (Unconventional Gas) – Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Gas Corporate & Commercial Legal Practice in the Upstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Gas Corp & Commercial Legal Practice provides legal support to the company’s upstream unconventional gas business, including drilling, production, processing and day-to-day operations as well as related joint ventures and subsidiaries.

As Senior Counsel, your primary role is to provide comprehensive corporate and commercial legal services, working closely with internal stakeholders and coordinating with specialist legal teams in areas such as tax, intellectual property (IP), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and dispute resolution. The role will require collaboration with external legal counsel as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and legal agreements.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal clients, identifying and mitigating potential legal risks while supporting business objectives.
  • Lead or support multidisciplinary legal and commercial projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Advise on claims management and dispute resolution processes.
  • Serve as Board Secretary for designated joint ventures and subsidiaries.
  • Manage relationships with external legal counsel, including oversight of legal budgets and service quality.

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor of Law degree as minimum. Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 10 years experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. Preferably within a major international or national energy company or oilfield services organization.
  • Demonstrated in-depth understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly unconventional gas operations.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements and deliver clear, practical legal advice to business clients.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship experience, with the ability to guide junior legal professionals.

description:
Visão Geral

O Profissional será responsável por realizar levantamentos de dados funcionais e estruturais do pavimento utilizando tecnologias e equipamentos, como Road Master, garantindo a precisão e a qualidade das informações coletadas. Conferir os dados obtidos, enviar relatórios diários para a coordenação da área e reportar diariamente a produção e eventuais ocorrências ao setor de pavimentos. Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o levantamento dos dados técnicos de monitoramento de pavimento.
  • Conduzir análises preliminares a fim de verificar a consistência e a aderência dos dados com a realidade de campo.
  • Elaborar relatórios/resumos de entregas diariamente.
  • Apoiar no processo de gestão de manutenções e na operação dos equipamentos de campo.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de engenharia para garantir agilidade, qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Técnico em Estradas e/ou similares
  • Experiência em levantamento de dados funcionais e estruturais em rodovias
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em campo

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica Unimed – Cuidando da sua saúde.
  • Unimed Odonto – Cuidando do seu sorriso com a qualidade Unimed.
  • Seguro de Vida – Mais segurança para você e sua família.
  • PPR – Participação nos Resultados – Reconhecimento pelo seu esforço.
  • Cartão Flash – Flexibilidade para usar como Alimentação ou Refeição.

Sobre a empresa

A EPR é uma plataforma de investimentos em concessões de rodovias e mobilidade. Nosso propósito é prestação de serviços de excelência aos usuários, administração e realização de investimentos consistentes para modernização e manutenção das rodovias concedidas, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento sustentável das regiões que atuamos. A empresa é a consolidação da parceria da Equipav, com mais de 60 anos de experiência em infraestrutura, com a Perfin, gestora de fundos de investimentos em infraestrutura. Administramos seis concessões de rodovias no Estado de Minas Gerais e Paraná. A EPR Triângulo, a EPR Sul de Minas, EPR Vias do Café e EPR Via Mineira operam no estado mineiro e a EPR Litoral Pioneiro e EPR Iguaçu em rodovias paranaenses.

title: Site Manager (Umuarama/PR)
description:
Overview

Ei, quer fazer parte de algo grande? Curte a ideia de trabalhar em um lugar onde suas ideias são super bem-vindas e os desafios te fazem crescer todo dia?

Então, se liga: a SolarVolt pode ser o seu próximo passo! Somos a galera da energia solar, apaixonados por inovar e levar mais energia limpa para todo o Brasil. Somos uma das maiores empresas do segmento, primeira empresa a ser certificada com três selos nível máximo pela Absolar, e a maior integradora WEG de Minas Gerais.

OBRA COM DURAÇÃO DE APROXIMADAMENTE 4 MESES

Sabemos que a chave para o crescimento está numa equipe de alto desempenho, e por isso procuramos uma pessoa para ingressar como SITE MANAGER, para atuação em uma obra determinada em Umuarama/PR.

Principais desafios do seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanhamento da Execução de Obras: Acompanhar a execução da obra civil realizada pelo cliente, garantindo a conformidade com as exigências do projeto e verificando o cumprimento do cronograma.
  • Emissão de Relatórios: Emitir relatórios detalhados sobre o progresso da obra, destacando avanços, possíveis desvios e sugestões de ajustes necessários.
  • Desenvolvimento de Indicadores de Performance: Elaborar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para monitorar a produtividade e eficiência das equipes em campo, promovendo o acompanhamento contínuo da execução da obra.
  • Participação em Reuniões de Alinhamento: Participar de reuniões periódicas com o cliente e a Gerência para alinhamento de informações, resolução de problemas e atualização do status do projeto.
  • Realização de Outras Atividades Correlatas: Executar outras atividades relacionadas conforme a necessidade do setor e orientação da chefia imediata.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte deste time:

  • Graduação Superior Completa.
  • Experiência com obras no setor solar ;
  • Vivência com acompanhamento de obras civis;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;

O que a SolarVolt oferece:

  • Vale Refeição ou alimentação - para ter energia
  • Assistência médica e odontológica (urgência e emergência) - afinal precisamos cuidar da nossa saúde
  • Carro para deslocamento - para ir até sua obra
  • Seguro de vida - para nos resguardarmos no dia a dia
  • Day Off no aniversário - para que você curta esse dia especial
  • Gympass – para você praticar o que mais gosta
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas fortalecem nosso time. Nossa empresa não faz distinção de gênero, raça, religião, idade, orientação sexual ou condição física. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a participar do processo seletivo.

Estamos em busca de uma Agente de Agendamento para se juntar à nossa equipe. Sua principal missão será garantir que nossos clientes executivos tenham uma experiência fluida e eficiente ao agendar seus check-ups.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Agendamento Ativo: Atendimentos a executivos das empresas para agendar seu check-up.

  • Gestão Financeira: Abrir Ordens de Serviço no sistema financeiro e realizar relatórios semanais para empresas-clientes, informando o status dos agendamentos.

Perfil do Candidato:

  • Faixa Etária: 22 a 50 anos
  • Características Principais: Postura cordial e educada, experiência com envio de e-mails e sistemas de cadastro/agendamento, organização, proatividade, excelente escrita e dicção.
  • Formação: Curso de atendimento ao cliente, ou formação em Letras, Comunicação e correlatas.
  • Habilidades Pessoais: Comunicativa, ótima locução verbal, simpática, organizada, assídua, paciente, empática, colaborativa.

  • Experiência Profissional: Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência com agendamento.

Por Que Juntar-se a Nós?

Há mais de 25 anos realizando diagnósticos na área de saúde.

O Vita Check-up é um dos principais centros de check-up de saúde do país e nasceu para contribuir que as pessoas conheçam a sua saúde e se conscientizem da importância das ações preventivas podendo viver mais e melhor. Nossa missão é proporcionar uma experiência única na realização de check-up com alta qualidade, empatia, inovação e atendimento humano.

Oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico, onde você poderá desenvolver suas habilidades e crescer na sua carreira. Venha fazer parte de uma equipe dedicada a transformar leads em oportunidades e resultados concretos com Excelência, Seriedade e Integridade!

Job description

Seja parte de uma comunidade comprometida para que cada criança e jovem possa construir e alcançar seus sonhos!

Na Tom Educação, acreditamos que a chave para transformar o futuro está em uma educação pública de qualidade. Nossa missão é desenvolver uma comunidade visceralmente comprometida para que todos os estudantes possam construir e alcançar seus sonhos.

A Tom Educação cuida da parte administrativa de escolas públicas por meio de parcerias público-privadas estaduais e municipais. Ao cuidar de toda a parte não-pedagógica da escola, a Tom permite que os diretores das escolas tenham mais tempo para o que mais importa: cuidar dos nossos alunos.

Como Coordenador(a) Administrativo(a) Escolar, você será a liderança responsável pelos temas administrativo-operacionais da escola, garantindo organização, segurança, funcionalidade e eficiência na rotina. Seu trabalho assegura que a equipe pedagógica tenha as condições necessárias para dedicar tempo e atenção aos estudantes, enquanto a escola opera com qualidade e foco em resultados concretos alinhados às necessidades da comunidade escolar e dos objetivos educacionais.

Essa posição é uma peça-chave para o sucesso das operações escolares, garantindo que as questões não-pedagógicas sejam resolvidas com excelência e que o suporte ao Diretor Pedagógico permita o aumento da frequência e do aprendizado dos estudantes.

É o cargo ideal para pessoas que estão buscando oportunidades de liderança reais para transformar a educação brasileira onde ela tem mais potencial: nas escolas públicas.

Main responsibilities

  • Implementação do "Setup" da Tom: Durante os 3 primeiros meses, o Coordenador Administrativo será o responsável pela mudança completa que ocorrerá dentro da escola - desde o processo de contratação de professores para zerar aulas vagas até as obras de infraestrutura e reformas que ocorrerão.
  • Liderança Administrativa e Operacional: Gerenciar as atividades administrativas da escola, incluindo as áreas de merenda, inspetoria, limpeza, manutenção, serviços gerais e matrículas. Garantir que os processos operacionais estejam organizados e que as necessidades do dia a dia sejam atendidas de forma eficiente.
  • Apoio ao Diretor Pedagógico: Trabalhar em conjunto com o Diretor Pedagógico para apoiar ações e projetos pedagógicos que visem o aumento da frequência escolar e da aprendizagem dos estudantes. Facilitar a execução de iniciativas que conectem as atividades pedagógicas às necessidades operacionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de Relações Comunitárias: Representar a Tom Educação na comunidade escolar, estabelecendo e fortalecendo relacionamentos com pais, alunos, funcionários e autoridades locais. Trabalhar para elevar a taxa de aceitação do Programa Parceiro da Escola.
  • Conformidade com Regulamentações e Indicadores: Monitorar e garantir que a escola cumpra as normas regulatórias, os contratos estabelecidos e os indicadores de desempenho definidos. Trabalhar para assegurar a transparência na gestão e a aderência às políticas públicas e internas.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior completa e, preferencialmente, especialização na área de Gestão Escolar.
  • Habilidades de Liderança: Capacidade de liderar equipes, promover um ambiente colaborativo e motivar os colaboradores para o alcance de metas comuns.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Excelentes habilidades organizacionais, com capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades de forma eficiente.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades sólidas de comunicação verbal e escrita, com aptidão para interagir efetivamente com diversos stakeholders, incluindo pais, professores, alunos e autoridades locais.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de identificar desafios e desenvolver soluções práticas e eficazes, demonstrando proatividade e iniciativa.
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal: Facilidade para construir e manter relacionamentos positivos, demonstrando empatia e sensibilidade às necessidades da comunidade escolar.
  • Excelência Operacional e Gestão de Processos: Capacidade de garantir coerência, qualidade e eficiência na execução dos processos escolares, com foco em planejamento, monitoramento de resultados e melhoria contínua.

Additional information

Cadastro e Comunicação

Faça seu cadastro com o e-mail e contato que você mais utiliza .

  • Verifique também sua caixa de spam — nossos comunicados oficiais serão enviados para os dados informados no cadastro.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

As pontuações individuais não são divulgadas.

  • Os candidatos são convocados para a próxima fase conforme o ranking de resultados.

Inclusão e Diversidade

  • Valorizamos a equidade, a diversidade e a inclusão em nossa cultura organizacional.
  • Todas as vagas são abertas a todos os públicos.
  • Caso você seja Pessoa com Deficiência (PCD) e precise de algum ajuste no processo seletivo , entre em contato conosco para informar suas necessidades pelo número .

Documentação Obrigatória

Em caso de aprovação no processo seletivo, será necessário apresentar:

  • Documentos pessoais: RG, CPF e comprovante de escolaridade ;
  • Certidão de conclusão de curso ;
  • Certidão de antecedentes criminais atualizada , conforme exigência da Lei nº 14.811/2024 , que reforça a proteção e o bem-estar de crianças e adolescentes.

Essa medida reflete nosso compromisso com a segurança, o respeito e a integridade da comunidade escolar.

⚖️ Compliance e Política de Parentesco

  • Ao final do processo seletivo, verificamos possíveis vínculos de parentesco com colaboradores da TOM , em conformidade com a LGPD .

Importante: ter parentes na TOM não impede a participação , porém não contratamos parentes até o 3º grau do(a) diretor(a) escolar para atuar na mesma unidade , nem parentes de 1º grau em relação de subordinação direta com outro profissional da instituição. We believe in ownership : you build it, you run it . We subscribe to this core principle of the DevOps movement. There is no dedicated Ops team who you can pass on the responsibility to take your code and make sure it runs reliably and scales to customers’ needs.

Does this sound like an environment you want to work in? Then you could bet the right person to be an engineer at epilot!

No nosso time de Engenharia, transformamos ideias em código e desafios em soluções escaláveis. Criamos estruturas seguras, confiáveis e de alta performance que garantem a excelência das nossas soluções e sustentam o crescimento do EBANX.

Temos oportunidades abertas para diferentes níveis, de início de carreira até posições de liderança. Se você se identificou, mesmo que não atenda a todos os requisitos,queremos muito conhecer você!

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está transformando o futuro dos pagamentos com impacto real — vem com a gente! Vamos fazer história juntos?

  • Colaborar com outras áreas para entender as necessidades dos usuários e entregar valor com tecnologia
  • Aprender constantemente e contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time

O que você precisa ter para brilhar nessa função

  • Vontade de fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, colaboração e inovação;
  • Experiência ou interesse em desenvolvimento backend, frontend ou fullstack;
  • Conhecimento em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (como PHP, Java, Python, Node.js, etc.);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente no escritório de Curitiba;

title: Assoc Clinical Lead
description:
Job Overview

Associate Clinical Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, working alongside clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Associate Clinical Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for clinical delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies and practices. Associate Clinical Leads partner with Project Leaders and other functional teams to ensure delivery requirements are met at all times.

Essential Functions

  • Ensure clinical delivery of assigned projects in compliance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonization (ICH)-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), customer requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), project plans).
  • Accountable for meeting projects’ recruitment targets and ensuring appropriate recruitment strategies are in place.
  • Contribute to the development of the project risk mitigation plan and manage clinical risks throughout the project’s lifecycle.
  • Ensure clinical quality delivery by identifying quality standards/requirements, planning how compliance will be measured, monitoring and overseeing management of clinical quality issues.
  • Manage clinical aspects of Project Finances including Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and create plans to deliver. Monitor and manage changes against baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify additional service opportunities or out of scope work.
  • Identify clinical stakeholder landscape for the project and manage both internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and resolution management.
  • Collaborate with the clinical team to support milestone achievements. Report to internal and external stakeholders as per project scope requirements.
  • Resourcing and Talent Planning of the clinical team. Manage the clinical team at project level to successfully deliver the project through the establishment of high-quality operational plans and guidance and project related trainings.
  • Conduct regular team meetings and communicate appropriately to achieve objectives.
  • Support professional development by providing feedback to clinical team line managers on performance relative to project tasks.
  • May work as the sole Clinical Lead on projects with 1-2 service lines and single/few countries or alongside more senior Clinical Leads to deliver large, global trials.
  • May attend site visits as applicable in support of project delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in health care or other scientific discipline.
  • Requires 3 years clinical research/monitoring experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Requires good knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
  • Requires broad protocol knowledge and therapeutic knowledge.
  • Requires good understanding of Clinical Research industry (drug/device/technology/etc.) and the relevant environments in which it operates.
  • Requires basic understanding of project finances.
  • Knowledge of clinical trials – application of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e., International Conference on Harmonization (ICH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct.
  • Communication – strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
  • Problem solving – problem solving skills.
  • Organization – planning, time management and prioritization skills.
  • Prioritization – ability to handle conflicting priorities.
  • Quality – attention to detail and accuracy in work.
  • Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output.
  • IT skills – good software and computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Collaboration – ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.
  • Cross-collaboration – ability to work across cultures and geographies with a high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.
  • Effective communication – ability to influence without authority.
  • IQVIA Core Competencies – ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Steam Turbine & Generators (STG) Head of Service Sales LATAM

A Snapshot of Your Day
The Steam Turbine & Generators (STG) Head of Service Sales for Latin America region is responsible for all the service sales related activities in the region and ensuring customer satisfaction in an installed base of close to 5000 units across different countries and industrial verticals.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • You will lead a team of client managers and marketing professionals (quotation/bid management professionals) located across the region including Mexico, Trinidad Tobago, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, Peru, and Chile
  • You will be responsible for all the sales related activity in the region and to deliver on all the main sales related KPIs such as Order entry, profit, revenue, market share, customer satisfaction etc.
  • You will ensure smooth coordination and regular communication with all the different factories and support team located in different parts of the world- including Germany, Sweden, Brazil and India
  • You will work towards achieving high level of motivation and satisfaction in your team by ensuring vertical and horizontal growth opportunities for your team, organizing learning and development programs and promote a healthy & transparent work culture.
  • You will conduct market research and analysis to identify new business opportunities, monitor competitors' activities, and stay up-to-date with industry trends and customer requirements.
  • You will ensure that the regional and global business strategy is understood and cascaded down and communicated effectively in the organization.
  • You will work with different product and service lines such as Spare Parts, Long term maintenance plans (LTPs), Repair, Mods & Ups, Revamps etc and ensure equal and dedicated focus on each of them.
  • You will ensure high level of customer satisfaction and engagement (measure by means of NPS scores) and thus ensuring a high service backlog which will be critical for business continuity.
  • You will ensure strong collaboration with other Siemens Energy teams with respect to customer relationship management and opportunity development.
  • You will work very closely with the new units sales team focusing on offering a complete end-to-end product across the lifecycle to the customers

What You Bring

  • Completed post-secondary education – University/College
  • Proficiency in English and Spanish/Portuguese language is very important.
  • 12-14 years’ total experience in a sales & business development profile
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a leadership role
  • Understand the Latin America energy and industrial market.
  • Experience in turbomachinery/rotating equipment services market will be a plus
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities by delivering on each quarter’s performance while building a pipeline for long-term success.
  • Right leadership mindset to grow and develop people.
  • Willingness to travel across Latin America region (up to 40/50% of the time)

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Supportive work culture
  • Company paid Health and wellness benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • Profit Sharing Program

Portanto, você irá efetuar uma venda consultiva com múltiplos stakeholders (CFO, franqueador / licenciador, unidades franqueadas ou licenciadas). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado.

Sobre a Conta Azul

A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Mapear o mercado de franquias / licenciadores com PMEs no Brasil e identificar oportunidades de negócios.
  • Construir e validar o perfil ideal de cliente (ICP).
  • Realizar prospecção outbound (CFOs, Controllers, Diretores) - Inside Sales e Field Sales.
  • Conduzir reuniões diagnósticas e orquestrar POCs com suporte do time de produto e tech.
  • Trabalhar com áreas de RevOps e Pricing para montar propostas comerciais.
  • Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala.
  • Estabelecer relações comerciais duradouras com foco em geração de valor mútuo.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Necessários

  • Capacidade de gerar interesse e marcar reuniões com decisores a partir do zero.
  • Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza‑se de análises para traduzir contextos.
  • Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento.
  • Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos.
  • Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha‑ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados.
  • Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos‑chave de contato para o novo cliente.
  • Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects.
  • Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário.
  • Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizar crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado.

Desejáveis

  • Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos.
  • Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica‑se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato.
  • Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e / ou licenciadores.
  • MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores).

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde: cobertura nacional sem custo de mensalidade ou coparticipação. Pode ser estendido a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), conforme política interna.
  • Plano odontológico: cobertura nacional sem custo de mensalidade. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos e cônjuges) conforme política interna.
  • Benefício flexível: R$ 1.000,00 por mês para investir em educação (70% de reembolso em mensalidades), idiomas (70%), atividades físicas e atendimento com psicólogos(as), nutricionistas, massoterapeutas e fisioterapeutas (50%).
  • Auxílio creche para papais e mamães com filhos entre 0 e 24 meses.
  • Auxílio Home Office mensal apoio mensal a partir de R$ 150,00 (de acordo com a localidade).
  • Auxílio Home Office: parcela única de R$ 1.500,00 para custear a estação de trabalho.
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação: cartão Flash sem desconto em folha.
  • Zenklub: acesso ilimitado a psicólogos, terapeutas, coaches e psicanalistas. As duas primeiras sessões do mês são gratuitas, e as demais têm custo de apenas R$ 20,00.
  • Programa de bônus conforme atingimento de metas.
  • Benefício Farmácia: App Vidalink com subsídio de 75% para medicamentos com receita. Podendo se estender aos dependentes (filhos e cônjuges) conforme política interna.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.
  • Filiação gratuita ao Sesc: podendo estender os benefícios aos dependentes. A filiação garante acesso a diversas atividades e serviços com preços especiais, como educação, esportes, lazer, excursões, hotéis, programação cultural, assistência odontológica e nutrição. Você paga apenas pelas atividades que utilizar.
  • Transporte e Estacionamento: vale‑transporte (com desconto de até 6%) e estacionamento gratuito na sede (Joinville).
  • GoGood: Acesso a diversas academias em todo o Brasil com subsídio de 50% para Azuis. Dependentes podem aderir ao plano integral.
  • Auxílio Mudança: Para todos os Azuis que têm o desejo de estar mais próximo da sede, oferecemos uma ajuda de custo para apoiar neste processo.

Pacote de Experiências

  • Baby Blue Time: jornada menor de trabalho com flexibilidade extra de horário nos retornos das licenças maternidade e paternidade.
  • Days Off Experience: Todos os Azuis com mais de 1 ano de casa poderão ter 4 folgas no ano.

E mais
